s.note: Lex Luthor's fundraiser in his library
s.how: Top 16 blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon. Halve 6 fresh figs, top each with a little goat's cheese and drizzle with honey. Arrange both on silver trays and hand them round like a billionaire's library gala.

s.note: Bruce's glass house by the lake
s.how: Spread rye crispbreads with creme fraiche. Flake 200g smoked trout over the top. Finish each with a few thin rings of pickled onion and a sprig of dill. Serve cold on a slate, the way they might at a glass house on a lake.

m.how: Sear a 1kg beef fillet all over and brush with mustard. Cook 400g chopped mushrooms with garlic until dry. Lay prosciutto on puff pastry, spread with mushrooms, wrap the beef, brush with egg and bake at 210C for 35 minutes. Rest 10 minutes.

w.how: Butter and sugar 4 ramekins. Melt 150g dark chocolate, stir in 3 egg yolks. Whisk 4 egg whites with 60g sugar to soft peaks, fold in and fill the ramekins. Bake at 190C for 12 minutes and serve with 200ml cream.

d.note: Bruce's glass house by the lake
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice, add a few thin slices of fresh ginger and the juice of half a lime to each and top with 250ml cold ginger beer.
